title: Obnoxiously Drunk Cousins Refuse To Listen To Police, Doesn’t End Well
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On July 24th, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a club about a highly intoxicated man who was disturbing the peace & refusing to leave. The man was also accompanied by his highly intoxicated cousin. Throughout the night, the two cousins would continue to disregard officers' commands & be belligerent to the extent that officers had to place both of them under arrest.  This is footage of the events that followed.
